metadata.title: Surreal Desert Gas Station Album Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring a weathered wooden gas station building isolated in a vast, dark sand desert under a twilight sky. The building's windows reveal bright, daylight mountain landscapes, creating a spatial paradox. A glowing blue neon title is set into the foreground sand at an angle.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark desert floor and the warm, lit gas station facade
Spatial paradox between the exterior night setting and the daylight mountain views inside windows
Diagonal tension between the horizontal building and the upward-sloping neon text
Juxtaposition of rustic wood textures with high-tech neon glow
coreInvariants: The building must appear as a flat, facade-like structure in an empty landscape
Windows must show a different environment (snowy mountains) than the surrounding desert
The foreground text must be rendered as physical neon tubing with a blue glow and cast shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The gas station is positioned in the upper third of the frame, appearing small against the vast foreground desert.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The warm, illuminated gas station facade acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the glowing neon text in the bottom left, follows its diagonal path upward toward the building, and settles on the mountain views in the windows.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark, textured sand in the lower two-thirds of the image creates a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and muted brown (desert sand and building wood)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright sky blue and white (mountain scenes and neon glow)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and red (gas pumps and interior lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the desert environment contrasted with high-value, saturated light sources (neon and window views).
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones, twilight blues, and artificial neon

letterConstructionRules: Glyphs are formed by continuous glass tubing
Rounded terminals and joints typical of neon bending
Double-line effect where tubes overlap or run parallel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are angled to match the perspective of the desert floor
Each letter casts a soft, dark shadow onto the sand

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the environment as a physical object

treatment.shadow: Soft, directional drop shadow on sand

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern neon display type contrasted with traditional, weathered serif signage.

avoid: Horizontal alignment for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the physical glass tube appearance

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle shot of a weathered wooden gas station in a dark, rippled sand desert at dusk. The station has two vintage pumps. The windows of the station show bright, sunny, snow-capped mountain peaks. The sky is a pale, hazy blue-grey.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large title in the foreground sand using bright blue neon glass tubing. The text should be angled diagonally upwards from left to right, following the perspective of the ground, and cast soft shadows on the sand.

verificationChecks: Does the neon text have a realistic glow and shadow?
Are the mountain scenes inside the windows significantly brighter than the desert exterior?
Is the desert sand textured with ripples?
Is the building centered in the upper half of the frame?

adjustableVariables: Specific mountain range shown in windows
Weathering level of the gas station
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the gas pumps
Specific band names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the neon text appears to sit 'in' the sand, not just 'on' it.
Verify the light from the neon reflects slightly on the nearby sand.
Check that the mountain scenes are properly masked within the window frames.
Confirm the diagonal perspective of the text matches the ground plane.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Landscape] + [Isolated Architecture] + [Internal/External Environment Paradox] + [Integrated Neon Typography].
